subject: Render DELTA4 final: options compile + v3 vertex/base/flat host PASS
body:
DELTA4 final render checkpoint:
- Generic default and variant compilation now calls tegu_mali_compile_generic_pair_options with DRAW_PARAMETERS|EXTENDED_VARYINGS (+SELECT_RT/TILE), stores varying info/pair flags/sysval mask. Variant keys hash the full options struct in addition to module bytes, tables, RT/tile and planner sidecar.
- Nonzero vertexStart, native indexed BaseVertex, BaseInstance and flat varyings flow into n2mb_draw_v3. CPU index expansion with VertexIndex still refuses. Flat line lists refuse explicitly (arch9 line-DRAW gap).
- Immutable one-level samplers remain on the legacy q word for v3-only draws; mip/array immutable still refuses.
- Host tests PASS both binaries (stub + real 7dd7442 bridge snapshot; active bridge remains mid-TLS edit): authored start3, indexed baseVertex5, real PointWarp flat, flat-line refusal, options key change, v2 mips/early release, magma, ASTC, shadow, CPU. ARM64 syntax PASS; iosurface PASS; diffcheck clean.
- Current production hashes encoder a1d201fd..., pipeline d92aa559..., submit cf126f75..., test ef0da886....
- Integration current-compiler case lists posted in previous message (19 not-32bit / 19 more-generic / 13 smooth-perspective; task's 18/12 likely filtered). No native/phone/publish/commit.
